summary: VS MEDIA Holdings, a BVI-domiciled, Hong Kong-based advertising company listed on the NYSE, filed a 6-K reporting that on September 15, 2026 it entered eight loan conversion agreements with individual accredited lenders, converting an aggregate US$830,952.46 of principal from unsecured August 3, 2026 six-month 10% loans into equity at US$0.41 per Class A ordinary share; accrued interest was fully forgiven and cancelled. The company issued 1,811,848 shares plus 214,866 pre-funded warrants exercisable at US$0.001, issued privately under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D with 4.99% beneficial-ownership caps. Watch for dilution, warrant exercises and overhang, and registration via the referenced F-3.
